title: Triangle of Power
summary: 3Blue1Brown presents the Triangle of Power, an alternate notation that unifies powers, logarithms and roots in a single triangular symbol. The video shows how the inverse operations relate and how the notation could help.
why: HN points to it in notation debates as a clean visual demonstration that exponents, logs and roots are three views of one relationship.

quote.text: My favorite new math notation is the triangle of power
